research_thread.scientific_problem: Assessing the reliability and transferability of machine learning models trained on ordered compound databases for predicting elastic moduli of disordered refractory high-entropy alloys (HEAs).
research_thread.material_system: NbTaTiV refractory HEA and broader class of disordered solid-solution alloys.
research_thread.sample_lineage: Training dataset from Materials Project (ordered compounds); NbTaTiV (disordered) used for validation.
research_thread.intervention: Training gradient-boosted tree ML models on DFT-calculated moduli and elemental features; testing on 20% held-out dataset and comparing to experimental/DFT values for NbTaTiV.
research_thread.baseline: Materials Project database (ordered compounds only); standard DFT calculations.
research_thread.conditions: 20% testing split, 20 different dataset shuffles, log-normalized modulus values, convergence threshold at 3000 samples.
research_thread.structure: Ordered crystal structures in training set vs. disordered BCC solid solution in NbTaTiV.
research_thread.outcome: ML models predicted shear modulus (36.6 GPa) and bulk modulus (146.3 GPa) for NbTaTiV with MSEs of 0.0409 and 0.0284 (relative errors 2.5% and 6%), converging at 3000 samples.
research_thread.mechanism: Feature selection via genetic algorithm identified Holder means of group numbers, cohesive energy, atomic radii, electronegativity, and density as key predictors; lattice distortion effects in HEAs are hypothesized to be implicitly captured or negligible enough for conservative estimates.
research_thread.hypothesis_value: ML models trained on ordered compounds can serve as effective conservative estimators for HEA elastic moduli, potentially bypassing expensive DFT calculations for disordered systems, provided sufficient training data (>3000 samples) is available.
alternative_explanations: Model success is accidental or limited to specific VEC ranges.
Lattice distortion in HEAs causes systematic errors masked by averaging.
boundaries: Performance may degrade with high lattice distortion or specific disordered features not in ordered database.
Stochastic variability requires multiple shuffles for robustness.
null_or_negative_results: No negative results reported; model performed better than expected.
missing_information: Performance metrics for other disordered HEAs (e.g., TiZrNbMoV) to confirm transferability.
Sensitivity analysis of error vs. lattice distortion parameter magnitude.
Impact of specific feature combinations (Holder mean powers) on model robustness.
